title: Need feedback on kids learning Game
author: QuickTraining4473

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body:
without a demo its like ok its good. It has a couple of things that a kid might not grasp depend on your age group such as the light bulb.  I know alot of these types of games the tracing is hard. My 3 year old struggles with some of them for that even i do cause they don't do well with touch drag. You need to make sure you are testing on different size of devices as well. Cause smaller screens sometimes their touch and drag isn't the best vs a bigger tablet. 

You also need voice to tell kids what to do. Not all kids are going to be able to read. I know both my boys can read already but other kids won't be able to. Such as well done and praises will be very important. 

  
Also remove the stars..  You don't want to discourage kids unless you want a harder mode... maybe..  You want to always tell them they did it espeically when they are learning their ABCs.  

Your select a letter don't have locked letters just send them right in.. cause kids will want to click things or bother parents why can't I do this.  You are hitting a very young age group with this. NOW you can have them after they can go back and do any letter they want. You don't want to lock down learning espeically as a game.

Also kids want it to be funny and fun. Have apples rain down and there is your A. Maybe have a bee fly in your letter B. You need to really consider your age group. 

Lucas and friends is a good app to look at. Or even endless numbers app. 

Im a programmer/Mother so im always looking for more education apps my kids will like.

replies.author: QuickTraining4473
replies.body: Hey thank you for such a detailed feedback and i really liked the ideas that you have given. I will definitely try to implement these in the game.

comments.author: MeasIIDX
comments.body:
Seems nice for something that was created with the help of AI. I will say this category of edutainment is so overly saturated (and with a lot of good apps already). Take a look at RV AppStudio. They have 1 billion downloads and their whole thing is no ads or IAPs ever. 

If you're building this just to learn and explore what AI can produce. Neat! Otherwise, it will be tough to actually find users especially if you're building this to monetize it.

replies.author: QuickTraining4473
replies.body: Hey thanks for the feedback. And yes i had not built this keeping monetisation in mind. Its just that i asked chatgpt how to build app for kids and just went on building stuffs. But definable i will keep your tip in mind to maybe turn this app into something competitive!
